tests.name: Boot health — no panic / abort / watchdog reset
tests.description: Power the panel over USB-C (or press the reset button) and let it boot once. This item is the ABSENCE of a crash: it can only be ticked by hand after the board has been up and quiet.

tests.name: Board peripherals initialise (LED strip, codec, RGB panel, touch)
logSequence: DEV_DISPLAY_LCD: Successfully initialized LCD display: display_lcd

tests.name: Voice framework initialises (offline wake word + 21 command phrases)
logSequence: app_audio: DSP dot product: generic kernel linked

tests.name: LVGL display port and RGB panel are registered (the previous boot abort is gone)
tests.description: Look for the app_display panel line naming the RGB panel WITHOUT the "(not registered)" suffix, and no LVGL task restart. This is where the earlier firmware aborted with 'assert failed'.
logSequence: app_display: Panel 'display_lcd' from board 'esp32_s31_korvo_1': generic_rgb rgb 800x480$

tests.name: Firmware start line and console ready
LCD shows the four room cards (bathroom, hallway, office, living room)
tests.description: After boot, the 800x480 screen should show a 2x2 grid of room cards with current and target temperatures plus a footer with the link state. Tick when you can see it on the panel.

tests.name: Status LED strip lights (dim white while connecting, green when online)
tests.description: Watch the WS2812 strip at boot: it should glow dim white while Wi-Fi/MQTT connect, then turn green once the broker is up. Tick when you have seen it.

tests.notes: Real board: ESP32-S31-Korvo-1, firmware 1.0.0 (ELF 6d891b034). Established from the previous session's evidence: the firmware aborts at boot (assert failed / backtrace, then rst:0xc SW_CPU_RESET loop) and the RGB LCD stays black. The two LVGL-task starts and the 'assert failed' fall immediately after the display panel line; the LCD backlight comes on but nothing is drawn.
